title: Local and global solutions to continuous fragmentation-coagulation equations with vanishing diffusion and unbounded fragmentation and coagulation rates
summary: In the paper, we study spatially distributed particle systems whose time evolution is governed by vanishing diffusion in space $\mathbb{R}^d$, $d\ge 1$, and by size-continuous fragmentation and coagulation processes with unbounded rates. We show that for a large class of coefficients, such systems are classically locally well-posed, provided the diffusion and the coagulation processes are suitably dominated by the fragmentation.
